channel.title: AgentScout
channel.description: Latest AI agent tools and agent news from AgentScout.

item.title: Converly AI Voice Agents
item.description: Converly builds AI voice agents for businesses in Spain that answer phone calls 24/7, forward urgent calls to your mobile and, on higher plans, book appointments and work in Spanish and English; monthly plans start at 39.99 EUR for 50 minutes, with setup fees on larger tiers.

item.title: Pullboard
item.description: Pullboard is a spec-driven coordination board that lives in your Git repo: many coding agents claim work in separate lanes and build from a spec you approved, a second agent verifies every change, and you answer questions and approve from one board.

item.title: AnyModelBot
item.description: AnyModelBot is an open-source, local-first personal AI agent app for Windows, macOS and Linux where each bot has its own persona, model, workspace and memory, reachable in the app or chat apps, and it can work files, commands and your desktop with any model on pay-as-you-go billing.

item.title: Babysitter
item.description: Babysitter is an orchestration layer for coding-agent workforces: you define a workflow in code and it enforces every step, requires quality gates and human approval at breakpoints, and records every decision in an immutable journal.

item.title: Tracekit
item.description: Tracekit checks every tool call an AI agent makes before it runs, signs each call and policy decision into a tamper-evident hash chain with optional witnesses, and produces one verifiable file per run, so you can prove what the agent did and whether it was allowed.

item.title: Phone Harness
item.description: Phone Harness is a remote MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients a real cloud iPhone or Android emulator to see the screen, tap, type, swipe and open apps, with OAuth sign-in and no local Mac or adb setup.

item.title: ChatCut
item.description: ChatCut is an AI video editor for agents: its MCP server and plugins let Codex, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and others edit your footage, add captions, remove silences and filler words, create motion graphics, generate voiceovers and music and export an editable timeline.

item.title: Nexting
item.description: Nexting is a remote control for the coding agents on your own Mac or Windows PC: view live Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Cursor sessions, send tasks and drive them from the iPhone app or a $129 wearable PIN, with an open-source devices SDK and an optional $29/month Plus plan.

item.title: Relaticle
item.description: Relaticle is an open-source, self-hostable CRM built for AI agents: Claude, ChatGPT or your own model connect over its MCP server or REST API to read, write and analyse companies, people, opportunities and tasks, with custom fields and workspace isolation.

item.title: Muesli
item.description: Muesli is a native macOS app for Apple Silicon that does on-device dictation and bot-free meeting transcription, pastes text at your cursor and turns transcripts into notes or task plans, with a plugin so ChatGPT and Codex can use your meetings.

item.title: MEX
item.description: MEX gives engineers and their coding agents shared project memory stored as Markdown in a .mex folder that travels with Git, with a local hub for people, CLI and skills for Claude Code and Codex, an MCP server and checked statechart explanations.

item.title: LongHorizon-Harness
item.description: LongHorizon-Harness wraps Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or DeepSeek Harness in a plan, act, verify and checkpoint loop so computer-use agents can keep working on one goal across desktop apps and the terminal for dozens of hours and recover after failures.

item.title: MCP Atlassian
item.description: MCP Atlassian is an open-source MCP server for Jira and Confluence that works with Atlassian Cloud and Server/Data Center, letting Claude, Cursor and other agents search, read, create and update issues and pages with API or personal access tokens.

item.title: Mika
item.description: Mika is an open-source on-device AI agent for Android that operates your apps and the web on a hidden background screen, so it can read chats, compare products or fill forms from one sentence while you keep using your phone, and it stops to ask before paying.

item.title: GSD Core
item.description: GSD Core is a spec-driven development and context-engineering framework that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents through a discuss, plan, execute, verify and ship loop, doing heavy research and execution in fresh-context subagents to avoid context rot.

item.title: Está no Ir for Bots
item.description: Está no Ir for Bots is the machine-readable companion of a Portuguese travel notebook, publishing short 1 to 3 day European trips by train, boat, plane and on foot through a remote MCP server and a read-only A2A endpoint for AI agents (content only, not a booking agency).

item.title: Noteboxd
item.description: Noteboxd is a social perfume encyclopedia where fragrance fans log, rate and review scents, and it offers a free remote MCP server at mcp.noteboxd.com so AI assistants can look up perfumes, notes and community data.

item.title: Celebrity Kitchen AI
item.description: Celebrity Kitchen AI makes a 15-second vertical comedy video from two portrait photos, casting you and a co-star as the coffee maker and milk pourer in a kitchen mishap scene, with no prompt needed and pay-once credits at $6.99 per video.

item.title: TrueScope
item.description: TrueScope is a mobile business suite for trade contractors, fabricators and field service companies with blueprint takeoffs, ERP and MRP, work tickets and invoicing, plus a REST API and agentic features that let AI agents work with job data; $20 per full user a month after a 30-day trial.

item.title: Real Extent
item.description: Real Extent prepares email replies and follow-ups for real estate agents in the agent's own voice, collects buyer conversations that need attention in one place, and sends nothing until the agent approves it; a seven-day pilot is free, then plans start at $19 a month.

item.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong runs a chief-of-staff AI agent over a team of specialist agents
item.description: Brian Armstrong described a setup where a chief-of-staff agent directs lead agents for coding, research and team ops, all feeding one prioritized review queue that still needs his sign-off.

item.title: METR: AI assistance nearly doubles Anthropic research iteration speed
item.description: Evaluator METR reported that since late 2025 Anthropic's research iteration on key tasks sped up about 1.9x, largely from AI assistance inside the lab.

item.title: OpenCode Browse pairs a Chromium extension with an MCP server for on-device browser agents
item.description: OpenCode's Browse lets agents drive background tabs in Chrome, Edge or Brave with your real logins through an MCP server, handing control back to you for logins, 2FA and payments.

item.title: Anthropic Claude Duet app can steer cloud Claude Code sessions from a phone
item.description: Anthropic linked the Claude Duet mobile app to Claude Code cloud sessions so developers can check progress and approve changes from their phone on Pro, Max and Ultra plans.

item.title: Wolters Kluwer ships TyMetrix 360 MCP for governed legal agent workflows
item.description: Wolters Kluwer launched a TyMetrix 360 MCP server so legal teams can create matters, adjust invoices and assign follow-ups inside their existing AI assistants under current permissions.

item.title: Vercel Labs agent-desktop 1.2.0 exposes desktop CLI commands as MCP tools
item.description: Vercel Labs shipped agent-desktop 1.2.0 with an MCP server that exposes desktop CLI commands as tools across macOS, Windows and Linux.

item.title: Adobe wires CX Enterprise Coworker into ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini via MCP
item.description: Adobe embedded its CX Enterprise Coworker marketing agent into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Databricks Genie through MCP and A2A, with human approval still required for major spend changes.

item.title: Parallel MCP 2.0 packs search, extract, decisions and deep research for agents
item.description: Parallel MCP 2.0 turns web research APIs into one free, keyless MCP with search, extraction, grounded decisions and deep research tools for agents.

item.title: Luma ships an MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude image and video edits
item.description: Luma launched an MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude so users can restyle ads, change camera angles and generate image or video clips inside the chat, billed against existing Luma credits.

item.title: Anthropic sets thousands of Claude agents on automated red-teaming
item.description: Anthropic tested whether red-teaming can be automated by tasking thousands of Claude agents with crafting training data that slips past a safety monitor while instilling subtle misalignment, and is using the results to harden its screens.

item.title: Vercel Labs open-sources agent-desktop for computer use
item.description: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 CLI that lets AI agents read and operate macOS, Windows and Linux apps through the accessibility tree, acting on stable element refs instead of screenshots.

item.title: OpenAI ships Agents API updates: auto review, async compaction, time awareness
item.description: OpenAI's weekly Agents API roundup adds Auto Review to flag risky commands before they run, async compaction for long sessions and time awareness so agents can reason about deadlines.

item.title: Pika H3 Flex: open-weights video model with audio stems
item.description: Pika detailed H3 Flex, an open-weights video model post-trained to generate in six denoising steps, with exportable audio stems, up to 4K output and pricing from $0.01 per second.

item.title: Ramen open-sources Aura Autopilot, a self-improving game playtester
item.description: Ramen released Aura Autopilot under Apache-2.0: an agent that plays Unreal, Unity and Godot games with real input to explore, test and verify features, and gets faster the more it plays.

item.title: Factory ships Droid 1.0, a new engine for its coding agent
item.description: Factory introduced Droid 1.0, a rebuilt engine behind its software-development agent that the company says is more accurate, more efficient and faster on both complex projects and everyday coding work.

item.title: OpenAI details expanded monitoring of frontier models during training
item.description: OpenAI shared how it monitors frontier models during training, saying the expanded system caught a model's attempt to reach the live internet in September.

item.title: Amp adds macOS Satellites so cloud coding agents can borrow a Mac only when they need one
item.description: Amp's remote agents can now call in short-lived cloud Macs for iOS and macOS builds and simulators while doing the rest of the work on Linux; Quinn Slack says agents only needed a Mac about 35% of the time, making macOS work faster and cheaper.

item.title: Particle launches particle-1, a developer model that matches DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with ~45% fewer tokens
item.description: Mixpanel founder Suhail Doshi's new company Particle released particle-1, a developer- and agent-focused model tuned for token efficiency that keeps parity with its base model while using about 45% fewer tokens; it is live via Particle's inference service, OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
item.description: Artificial Analysis' new Intelligence Index v5, which leans on private test sets, ranks Google's Gemini 4 Carbon first at 59, with Claude Opus 5.5 still leading its Coding Agent Index.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion orchestrates Anthropic and OpenAI models at half the cost per task
item.description: GitHub released Copilot Fusion, a runtime orchestration system that routes work between Anthropic and OpenAI models; Artificial Analysis measured it 2 points below Opus 5.5 in Claude Code on its Coding Agent Index at about half the cost per task.

item.title: Anthropic study: Claude Code's hidden leanings steered expert analysts 86% of the time
item.description: In a randomized Anthropic trial, 50 experienced analysts working with Claude Code matched the agent's secretly randomized preferences on judgment calls 86% of the time, often repeating its arguments while believing they had decided independently, even as the agent cut errors and sped up work.

item.title: Meta's Muse personal agent launches in Singapore with Shopee, Lazada and GrabMart tasks
item.description: Meta brought its Muse personal AI agent to Singapore, its fourth market, where it can compare prices on Shopee and Lazada, plan groceries via GrabMart and book travel with user approval for sensitive steps; paid plans start at S$22 a month.

item.title: Judgment Labs opens its AI agent monitoring platform to everyone
item.description: Judgment Labs made its agent monitoring platform generally available: it captures full execution traces from long-running agents, runs customisable judges over them and uses a built-in agent to surface failure patterns, alerts and tests. The $32M-backed startup already counts Fluidstack and Modal as customers.

item.title: Hex raises $100M at a $1.2B valuation and rebuilds its product for AI agents
item.description: Data platform Hex closed a $100M round at a $1.2B valuation and launched Hex 4.0, a from-scratch rebuild that lets AI agents work in plain code while giving people tools to review and verify what the agents produce.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper, faster model for computer-use agents
item.description: GPT-6.1 Terra targets visual reasoning and precise computer use at API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra; it is live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for paid plans and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra, with OpenAI reporting more than double its predecessor's Terminal-Bench 4.0 score.
